Marks: 50                                                                                                      Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               An AC voltage of peak value 20V is connected in series with a silicon diode and load resistance of       (4)  
  500Ω. If the forward resistance of the diode is 10Ω, find (i) peak current through the diode and (ii)  
  peak output voltage. What will be these values if the diode is assumed to be ideal?  
1B)               Describe Zener breakdown and Avalanche breakdown. Under what conditions does each                        (3)  
  mechanism occur, and how do they differ in terms of operation and physical processes?  
1c)               With the help of circuit diagrams, explain the working of a full-wave bridge rectifier with a capacitive (3)  
  filter.  
2A)               A 12V Zener regulator has a minimum and maximum Zener current requirements of 1mA and                    (4)  
  32mA respectively. If the input voltage is 50V and the series resistance is 1kΩ, determine the  
  minimum and maximum load resistances and the corresponding load currents  
2B)               For the circuit shown, assuming that the MOSFET is in saturation, determine the drain current and (3)  
  drain-to-source voltage if µn C ox W/L= 5mA/V2 and VTh = 0.5V. Suppose if VGS is increased by 0.5V,  
  what is the corresponding change in VDS?  
  
  
2C)               Explain the structure and working of N-channel MOSFET                                                    (3)
